style.vernacular: Kathmandu Valley at about 1,300 m: a dense core of Newar red-brick and carved-timber houses of three to four storeys with tiled pitched roofs, pagoda temples and brick-paved squares, surrounded by fast-growing blocks of 4-7 storey reinforced-concrete frame with brick infill, flat roofs with water tanks, and rebar stubs; Rana-era white neoclassical palaces; prayer flags and Buddha-eye stupas.
